_help: Single source of card data. Add a card per artifact. status: needs-you | to-read | decided. type: research | concept | review | diagram | prototype | decision | brief. round: id from rounds (omit for standing-only cards). section: design | prototypes | diagrams | research | map (standing sections). href: /docs/... serves repo docs read-only; other paths are hub files. needs-you cards show only under 'Needs your answer'. After editing, rebuild the walkthrough: bun hub/build.ts (serve.ts does this on start).
